reason: The fixtures hold the real generated files of PR #1370. Its commit 21f07dbe changed the domain contract and kept catalog digest 1c17f49a; that tree's own node scripts/catalog.mjs check reports stale-output for catalog.ts. The next commit in the PR only regenerated the two files to digest 452d0b35, and the commit between them changed no contract input, so 452d0b35 is what generate wrote for 21f07dbe. Since #1387 the catalog holds no digest, so the same mistake now comes from adding, renaming or removing an operation or its server without generate; the commit check runs only when such a file or a generated file is staged, copies the index into a scratch folder and judges that copy with the same judgeCatalog the push-time catalog test uses, so nothing on disk outside the index decides it; scripts/ocv-tools/jobs/catalog-index.test.mjs replays the untracked-operation and commit -a misses found in review. The guard-proof tag keeps 21f07dbe reachable.
